Mean per-capita agricultural output value, 2005–2023

Source: food and agriculture: annual agricultural producer price indices and yea…

figures.caption: Average Per-Capita Output Value by Income Group, shown to answer compare average per-capita agricultural output value across different country income groups. The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Statistics Division compiled country-level agricultural producer prices deflated by consumer price indices alongside gross per-capita agricultural output from 2005 to 2023. The dataset evaluates terms of trade shocks, commodity-specific volatility, and structural agricultural output differences across global income classifications.
